presentation.label: Real Units
presentation.summary: Knob values in hertz, milliseconds and note lengths: filter cutoff, envelope times and LFO cycles.
presentation.overview: Real Units, by ceredmeat, shows knob values in real units. FLTR FREQ shows the cutoff in hertz, the filter and amp envelopes show their times in milliseconds or seconds (INF at 127 where the stage holds), and the LFO pop-up adds the cycle length as bars or note values when it follows the tempo, or hertz when it runs free. Each number comes from the table the sound engine itself uses. Only the text changes: sounds, locks and saving are untouched. With a Machine Pages machine loaded, that machine keeps its own knob text.
highlights: FLTR FREQ in hertz, from 5.0 to 20.8k.
Filter and amp envelope times in milliseconds or seconds; INF where a stage holds.
The LFO pop-up adds the cycle length: bars, note values, or hertz when free-running.
Only the text changes; sounds, locks and saving are untouched.
usage: On an audio track open the FLTR page.
Turn FREQ: the value shows in hertz.
Turn the filter envelope ATK or DEC: the time shows in milliseconds or seconds.
On the LFO page turn SPD: the pop-up adds the cycle length as a note value.

steps: Use a build containing Real Units for the original Digitakt on OS 1.54.
Open the FLTR, AMP or LFO page of an audio track.
Turn a knob: its value shows in hertz, milliseconds or note lengths.

limitations: Needs core 4.1 or newer, so it does not build beside Digi EQ 1.0.2, which builds only on core 2.1.
Not with Note Accumulator: both patch the same value text code.
Decay times are the time to fall to a tenth: the fade is a curve with no hard end.
Delay TIME is unchanged: the stock pop-up already names its note values.

claims: ui:FLTR, AMP and LFO pages:knob value text

load.display: Runs on the UI side only, nothing in the audio render
load.conditions: From the source: its two hooks run when a knob's value text is drawn; it has no event handler in the render. Not measured on a unit in Modwerk.

hardware.summary: The author tested Ctrl All, Kit A/B and Real Units 0.2 on a Digitakt MKI on OS 1.54, together with seven other FLEXMODS mods, elekloader's core and seq-events (FLEXMODS 1.0, 16 November 2026; the same files ship unchanged through FLEXMODS 1.5). This module pins that released file.
limitations: The author's report gives no duration: testedOn is the FLEXMODS 1.0 release date.
Tested with elekloader's core and other FLEXMODS mods in the build, not with Modwerk's library mods.
Not tested in Modwerk on a unit.

tests.summary: The author's released 0.2 file, pinned unchanged, linked locally on OS 1.54 with core 4.4 beside every Digitakt mod in the library: it builds beside all of them except Digi EQ 1.0.2 (core 2.1 only) and Note Accumulator (the same code). Emulator captures show where it appears; nothing ran on a unit in Modwerk.
